name: Emperor Yōzei
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 13); Porter’s note gives the dates as: reigned 877–884; d. 949.

poems.title: The Mina stream comes tumbling down
poems.author: Emperor Yōzei
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 13
poems.text:
The Mina stream comes tumbling down
From Mount Tsukuba’s height;
Strong as my love, it leaps into
A pool as black as night
With overwhelming might.

poems.title: 13. 筑波嶺の 峯より落つる みなの川 (Tsukubane no mine yori otsuru Minano-gawa)
poems.author: Emperor Yōzei
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後撰集
poems.text:
筑波嶺の 峯より落つる みなの川
戀ぞつもりて 淵となりぬる
